name: Alpina Regina
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Alpina Regina in Tirol**

Discover the breathtaking beauty of the **Alps** in the heart of **Tirol**, where the **Alpina Regina** invites you to an unforgettable escape. Nestled in the stunning **Zillertal Valley**, this luxurious mountain retreat offers panoramic views of snow-capped peaks, lush meadows, and crystal-clear alpine lakes.

Indulge in authentic **Tiroler** hospitality with gourmet cuisine featuring local specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Käsespätzle**, and succulent **Tiroler Gröstl**. Our cozy **Hütten** and elegant **Almhütten** provide the perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort.

Whether you're hiking through pristine trails, skiing down pristine slopes, or simply relaxing with a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** and a warm **Kaffee**, the **Alpina Regina** promises an idyllic retreat in the embrace of the **Alps**.

**Come experience the magic of Tirol—where adventure and tranquility meet.**
